sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: AI Aimbot Models & YOLO Detection Models | MossyModels
sources.snippet: MossyModels is a community library of YOLO and ONNX detection models for first-person shooters. Browse models by game, compare download counts and ratings, then download free PyTorch or ONNX weights. How the library works Each game page lists community-uploaded detection models with version numbers, input sizes, and comments.
